name: 小红书财经爆款日报

on:
  # 定时触发：每天北京时间 06:00 (UTC 前一天 22:00)
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 22 * * *'

  # 手动触发
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN }}
  ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL }}
  XHS_COOKIES: ${{ secrets.XHS_COOKIES }}
  WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  generate-report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout 代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 设置 Python 环境
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 安装依赖
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 安装 xiaohongshu-mcp
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp/releases/download/v2026.01.17.0408-e467f84/xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64.tar.gz -O xiaohongshu-mcp.tar.gz
          tar -xzf xiaohongshu-mcp.tar.gz
          chmod +x xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64
          sudo mv xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/xiaohongshu-mcp
          xiaohongshu-mcp --version || echo "版本检查成功"

      - name: 准备小红书 Cookies
        run: |
          echo '${{ secrets.XHS_COOKIES }}' > /tmp/xhs_cookies.json
          echo "✓ Cookies 文件已创建"

      - name: 启动 xiaohongshu-mcp Server
        run: |
          echo "启动 MCP Server..."
          nohup xiaohongshu-mcp serve --port 18060 --cookies /tmp/xhs_cookies.json > /tmp/mcp_server.log 2>&1 &

          # 等待服务启动
          echo "等待 MCP Server 启动..."
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:18060/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "✓ MCP Server 已就绪"
              break
            fi
            echo "等待中... ($i/10)"
            sleep 2
          done

          # 检查是否成功启动
          if ! curl -s http://localhost:18060/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "✗ MCP Server 启动失败，查看日志："
            cat /tmp/mcp_server.log
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: 运行 Claude Agent
        run: |
          python scripts/claude_agent_runner.py
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL }}

      - name: 数据校验
        run: |
          python scripts/validate_data.py data.json

      - name: 生成报告并推送微信
        run: |
          python scripts/push_report.py --file data.json
        env:
          WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN }}

      - name: 上传报告数据（可选）
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: daily-report-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            data.json
          retention-days: 7

      - name: 清理
        if: always()
        run: |
          # 停止 MCP Server
          pkill -f xiaohongshu-mcp || true

          # 删除敏感文件
          rm -f /tmp/xhs_cookies.json
          rm -f data.json

          echo "✓ 清理完成"

      - name: 失败通知
        if: failure()
        run: |
          # 如果执行失败，发送通知到微信
          curl -X POST http://www.pushplus.plus/send \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "token": "${{ secrets.WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN }}",
              "title": "⚠️ 小红书爆款日报执行失败",
              "content": "GitHub Actions 执行失败，请查看日志: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}",
              "template": "markdown"
            }' || true

name: 小红书财经爆款日报

on:
  # 定时触发：每天北京时间 06:00 (UTC 前一天 22:00)
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 22 * * *'

  # 手动触发
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN }}
  ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL }}
  XHS_COOKIES: ${{ secrets.XHS_COOKIES }}
  WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  generate-report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout 代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 设置 Python 环境
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 安装依赖
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 安装 xiaohongshu-mcp
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp/releases/download/v2026.01.17.0408-e467f84/xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64.tar.gz -O xiaohongshu-mcp.tar.gz
          tar -xzf xiaohongshu-mcp.tar.gz
          chmod +x xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64
          sudo mv xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/xiaohongshu-mcp
          xiaohongshu-mcp --version || echo "版本检查成功"

      - name: 准备小红书 Cookies
        run: |
          echo '${{ secrets.XHS_COOKIES }}' > /tmp/xhs_cookies.json
          echo "✓ Cookies 文件已创建"

      - name: 启动 xiaohongshu-mcp Server
        run: |
          echo "启动 MCP Server..."
          nohup xiaohongshu-mcp serve --port 3000 --cookies /tmp/xhs_cookies.json > /tmp/mcp_server.log 2>&1 &

          # 等待服务启动
          echo "等待 MCP Server 启动..."
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "✓ MCP Server 已就绪"
              break
            fi
            echo "等待中... ($i/10)"
            sleep 2
          done

          # 检查是否成功启动
          if ! curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "✗ MCP Server 启动失败，查看日志："
            cat /tmp/mcp_server.log
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: 运行 Claude Agent
        run: |
          python scripts/claude_agent_runner.py
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL }}

      - name: 数据校验
        run: |
          python scripts/validate_data.py data.json

      - name: 生成报告并推送微信
        run: |
          python scripts/push_report.py --file data.json
        env:
          WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN }}

      - name: 上传报告数据（可选）
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: daily-report-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            data.json
          retention-days: 7

      - name: 清理
        if: always()
        run: |
          # 停止 MCP Server
          pkill -f xiaohongshu-mcp || true

          # 删除敏感文件
          rm -f /tmp/xhs_cookies.json
          rm -f data.json

          echo "✓ 清理完成"

      - name: 失败通知
        if: failure()
        run: |
          # 如果执行失败，发送通知到微信
          curl -X POST http://www.pushplus.plus/send \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "token": "${{ secrets.WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN }}",
              "title": "⚠️ 小红书爆款日报执行失败",
              "content": "GitHub Actions 执行失败，请查看日志: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}",
              "template": "markdown"
            }' || true

def start_mcp_server(cookies_path):
    """启动小红书 MCP HTTP Server"""
    print("启动小红书 MCP Server...")

    # 检查 xiaohongshu-mcp 是否存在（GitHub Actions 环境中已预安装）
    try:
        subprocess.run(["which", "xiaohongshu-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True)
        print("✓ xiaohongshu-mcp 已就绪")
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
        print("[Error] xiaohongshu-mcp 未找到")
        print("请确保在 GitHub Actions 中已正确安装 xiaohongshu-mcp")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 启动 MCP Server
    cmd = [
        "xiaohongshu-mcp", "serve",
        "--port", "3000",
        "--cookies", cookies_path
    ]

    process = subprocess.Popen(
        cmd,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True
    )

    # 等待服务启动
    print("等待 MCP Server 启动...")
    for i in range(15):
        try:
            response = requests.get("http://localhost:3000/health", timeout=2)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
                return process
        except:
            pass
        print(f"等待中... ({i+1}/15)")
        time.sleep(2)

    # 检查是否成功启动
    try:
        response = requests.get("http://localhost:3000/health", timeout=2)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
            return process
    except:
        pass

    print("[Error] MCP Server 启动失败")
    print("查看日志:")
    print(process.stderr.read())
    process.kill()
    sys.exit(1)


def run_claude_agent(api_key, base_url, config):
    """运行 Claude Agent"""
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("Claude Agent Runner - xhs-topic-analyzer")
    print("="*60)

    keywords = config.get("keywords", [])
    filters = config.get("filters", {})
    min_likes = filters.get("min_likes", 2000)

    keywords_str = "、".join(keywords)

    # 构建 MCP 工具配置
    tools = [{
        "type": "computer_20241022",
        "name": "mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds",
        "computer_20241022": {
            "mcp_server": {
                "url": "http://localhost:3000"
            }
        }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Claude Agent Runner for GitHub Actions
使用 Anthropic SDK (通过硅基流动代理) + 小红书 MCP 搜索爆款笔记
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import subprocess
import time
import requests
from datetime import datetime

try:
    from anthropic import Anthropic
except ImportError:
    print("正在安装 anthropic 包...")
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "anthropic"])
    from anthropic import Anthropic


def load_config():
    """加载配置文件"""
    config_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'config.json')
    try:
        with open(config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] 加载配置文件失败: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


def start_mcp_server(cookies_path):
    """启动小红书 MCP HTTP Server"""
    print("启动小红书 MCP Server...")

    # 检查 xiaohongshu-mcp 是否存在（GitHub Actions 环境中已预安装）
    try:
        subprocess.run(["which", "xiaohongshu-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True)
        print("✓ xiaohongshu-mcp 已就绪")
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
        print("[Error] xiaohongshu-mcp 未找到")
        print("请确保在 GitHub Actions 中已正确安装 xiaohongshu-mcp")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 启动 MCP Server
    cmd = [
        "xiaohongshu-mcp", "serve",
        "--port", "3000",
        "--cookies", cookies_path
    ]

    process = subprocess.Popen(
        cmd,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True
    )

    # 等待服务启动
    print("等待 MCP Server 启动...")
    for i in range(15):
        try:
            response = requests.get("http://localhost:3000/health", timeout=2)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
                return process
        except:
            pass
        print(f"等待中... ({i+1}/15)")
        time.sleep(2)

    # 检查是否成功启动
    try:
        response = requests.get("http://localhost:3000/health", timeout=2)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
            return process
    except:
        pass

    print("[Error] MCP Server 启动失败")
    print("查看日志:")
    print(process.stderr.read())
    process.kill()
    sys.exit(1)


def run_claude_agent(api_key, base_url, config):
    """运行 Claude Agent"""
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("Claude Agent Runner - xhs-topic-analyzer")
    print("="*60)

    keywords = config.get("keywords", [])
    filters = config.get("filters", {})
    min_likes = filters.get("min_likes", 2000)

    keywords_str = "、".join(keywords)

    # 构建 MCP 工具配置
    tools = [{
        "type": "computer_20241022",
        "name": "mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds",
        "computer_20241022": {
            "mcp_server": {
                "url": "http://localhost:3000"
            }
        }
    }]

    # 初始化 Anthropic 客户端
    print("\n[Step 1] 初始化 Anthropic 客户端...")
    print(f"  - Base URL: {base_url}")
    print(f"  - Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514")

    client = Anthropic(
        api_key=api_key,
        base_url=base_url
    )

    # 构建任务提示词
    print(f"\n[Step 2] 构建任务提示词...")
    task_prompt = f"""请执行小红书财经赛道爆款笔记分析任务：

## 🎯 任务目标
搜索小红书财经赛道关键词，提取近期爆款笔记（点赞≥2000）

## 📋 搜索关键词
{keywords_str}

## ⚙️ 搜索参数
每个关键词调用 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds，参数：
- keyword: <关键词>
- filters:
  - sort_by: "最多点赞"
  - publish_time: "一周内"
  - note_type: "不限"

## 🔍 执行步骤
1. 对每个关键词调用搜索 API
2. 合并所有搜索结果
3. 筛选条件：点赞数 ≥ {min_likes}
4. 去重（按笔记ID）
5. 按点赞数降序排列
6. 保存到 data.json 文件

## 📄 输出格式
```json
{{
  "feeds": [{{
    "id": "笔记ID",
    "title": "标题",
    "user": "博主昵称",
    "liked_count": 点赞数,
    "collected_count": 收藏数,

  }}],
  "total_feeds": <总数>,

}}
```

## ⚠️ 重要提醒

- 不能编造数据
- 需要完整搜索所有 {len(keywords)} 个关键词

请开始执行任务！
"""

    # 调用 Claude API
    print(f"\n[Step 3] 调用 Claude API...")
    print(f"  - Keywords: {len(keywords)} 个")
    print(f"  - Max tokens: 16384")
    print(f"  - Tools: mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds")

    try:
        response = client.messages.create(
            model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
            max_tokens=16384,
            tools=tools,
            messages=[{
                "role": "user",
                "content": task_prompt
            }]
        )

        print(f"\n  ✓ API 调用成功")
        print(f"  - Usage: {response.usage.total_tokens} tokens")
        print(f"  - Input: {response.usage.input_tokens} tokens")
        print(f"  - Output: {response.usage.output_tokens} tokens")

        return response

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n[Error] Claude API 调用失败: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)


def main():
    """主函数"""
    # 1. 检查环境变量
    api_key = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN")
    base_url = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "https://api.anthropic.com")
    cookies_json = os.environ.get("XHS_COOKIES")

    if not api_key:
        print("[Error] 缺少 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not cookies_json:
        print("[Error] 缺少 XHS_COOKIES 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 2. 保存 cookies 到临时文件
    cookies_file = "/tmp/xhs_cookies.json"
    with open(cookies_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(cookies_json)
    print(f"✓ Cookies 文件已创建: {cookies_file}")

    # 3. 启动 MCP Server
    mcp_process = start_mcp_server(cookies_file)

    try:
        # 4. 加载配置
        print("\n[Info] 加载配置文件...")
        config = load_config()
        print(f"✓ 已加载 {len(config.get('keywords', []))} 个关键词")

        # 5. 运行 Claude Agent
        response = run_claude_agent(api_key, base_url, config)

        # 6. 检查生成的数据文件
        print("\n[Step 4] 检查生成的数据文件...")
        data_file = "data.json"

        if os.path.exists(data_file):
            with open(data_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                data = json.load(f)

            feeds = data.get("feeds", [])
            print(f"✓ 数据文件已生成")
            print(f"  - 笔记数量: {len(feeds)}")

            if len(feeds) > 0:
                print(f"  - 示例: {feeds[0].get('title', 'N/A')[:50]}...")
                print(f"  - 总点赞数: {sum(f.get('liked_count', 0) for f in feeds):,}")

        else:
            print(f"[Warning] 未找到 {data_file}")
            print("[Info] Claude 响应内容:")
            print(response.content)

    finally:
        # 7. 清理：停止 MCP Server
        print("\n[Step 5] 清理资源...")
        mcp_process.terminate()
        mcp_process.wait()

        # 删除 cookies 文件
        if os.path.exists(cookies_file):
            os.remove(cookies_file)
            print(f"✓ 已删除 {cookies_file}")

        print("✓ 清理完成")

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("✓ Agent Runner 执行完成")
    print("="*60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

on:

env:

jobs:
  generate-report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout 代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 设置 Python 环境
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 安装依赖
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 安装 xiaohongshu-mcp
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp/releases/download/v2026.01.17.0408-e467f84/xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64.tar.gz -O xiaohongshu-mcp.tar.gz
          tar -xzf xiaohongshu-mcp.tar.gz
          chmod +x xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64
          sudo mv xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/xiaohongshu-mcp
          xiaohongshu-mcp --version || echo "版本检查成功"

      - name: 准备小红书 Cookies
        run: |
          echo '${{ secrets.XHS_COOKIES }}' > /tmp/xhs_cookies.json
          echo "✓ Cookies 文件已创建"

      - name: 启动 xiaohongshu-mcp Server
        run: |
          echo "启动 MCP Server..."
          nohup xiaohongshu-mcp serve --port :3000 --cookies /tmp/xhs_cookies.json > /tmp/mcp_server.log 2>&1 &

          # 等待服务启动
          echo "等待 MCP Server 启动..."
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "✓ MCP Server 已就绪"
              break
            fi
            echo "等待中... ($i/10)"

          if ! curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "✗ MCP Server 启动失败，查看日志："
            cat /tmp/mcp_server.log
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: 运行 Claude Agent
        run: |
          python scripts/claude_agent_runner.py
        env:

  2. 行 ~66, 77: 修改健康检查 URL `localhost:3000` → `localhost:18060`
  3. 行 ~183: 添加 `timeout=300` 参数到 Claude API 调用
  4. 行 ~109: 修改 MCP 工具配置中的端口
  5. 行 ~207: 在 main() 开始添加 `sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)`

- **/tmp/xhs-topic-analyzer/config.json** - 参考配置文件，了解 10 个关键词的配置，可用于优化（考虑减少关键词数量以提升性能）

- **/tmp/xhs-topic-analyzer/scripts/validate_data.py** - 数据验证脚本，修复完成后用于验证生成的 data.json 格式正确性

### 🎯 根本原因（三大问题叠加）：

1. **Python stdout 缓冲** - 导致 30 分钟执行期间没有任何日志输出，无法诊断问题
2. **Claude API 缺少 timeout** - 脚本可能在 API 调用处无限期挂起
3. **MCP Server 端口配置错误** - 脚本连接 3000，实际 MCP Server 启动在 18060

### 🔧 紧急修复优先级：

**P0（立即修复）**：

6. 考虑减少关键词数量或使用并行搜索

### 📊 性能优化建议：

- 当前设计让 Claude 循环调用 10 次 MCP 工具，效率较低
- 建议改为：脚本直接调用 MCP API（快 10 倍），然后一次性提交给 Claude 分析

name: 小红书财经爆款日报

on:
  # 定时触发：每天北京时间 06:00 (UTC 前一天 22:00)
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 22 * * *'

  # 手动触发
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN }}
  ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL }}
  XHS_COOKIES: ${{ secrets.XHS_COOKIES }}
  WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  generate-report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout 代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 设置 Python 环境
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 安装依赖
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 安装 xiaohongshu-mcp
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp/releases/download/v2026.01.17.0408-e467f84/xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64.tar.gz -O xiaohongshu-mcp.tar.gz
          tar -xzf xiaohongshu-mcp.tar.gz
          chmod +x xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64
          sudo mv xiaohongshu-mcp-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/xiaohongshu-mcp
          xiaohongshu-mcp --version || echo "版本检查成功"

      - name: 准备小红书 Cookies
        run: |
          echo '${{ secrets.XHS_COOKIES }}' > /tmp/xhs_cookies.json
          echo "✓ Cookies 文件已创建"

      - name: 运行 Claude Agent
        run: |
          python scripts/claude_agent_runner.py
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL }}

      - name: 数据校验
        run: |
          python scripts/validate_data.py data.json

      - name: 生成报告并推送微信
        run: |
          python scripts/push_report.py --file data.json
        env:
          WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN }}

      - name: 上传报告数据（可选）
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: daily-report-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            data.json
          retention-days: 7

      - name: 清理
        if: always()
        run: |
          # 停止 MCP Server
          pkill -f xiaohongshu-mcp || true

          # 删除敏感文件
          rm -f /tmp/xhs_cookies.json
          rm -f data.json

          echo "✓ 清理完成"

      - name: 失败通知
        if: failure()
        run: |
          # 如果执行失败，发送通知到微信
          curl -X POST http://www.pushplus.plus/send \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "token": "${{ secrets.WECHAT_PUSH_TOKEN }}",
              "title": "⚠️ 小红书爆款日报执行失败",
              "content": "GitHub Actions 执行失败，请查看日志: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}",
              "template": "markdown"
            }' || true

def start_mcp_server(cookies_path):
    """启动小红书 MCP HTTP Server"""
    print("启动小红书 MCP Server...")

    # 检查 xiaohongshu-mcp 是否存在（GitHub Actions 环境中已预安装）
    try:
        subprocess.run(["which", "xiaohongshu-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True)
        print("✓ xiaohongshu-mcp 已就绪")
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
        print("[Error] xiaohongshu-mcp 未找到")
        print("请确保在 GitHub Actions 中已正确安装 xiaohongshu-mcp")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 启动 MCP Server
    cmd = [
        "xiaohongshu-mcp", "serve",
        "--port", ":3000",
        "--cookies", cookies_path
    ]

    process = subprocess.Popen(
        cmd,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True
    )

    # 等待服务启动
    print("等待 MCP Server 启动...")
    for i in range(15):
        try:
            response = requests.get("http://localhost:3000/health", timeout=2)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
                return process
        except:
            pass
        print(f"等待中... ({i+1}/15)")
        time.sleep(2)

    # 检查是否成功启动
    try:
        response = requests.get("http://localhost:3000/health", timeout=2)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
            return process
    except:
        pass

    print("[Error] MCP Server 启动失败")
    print("查看日志:")
    print(process.stderr.read())
    process.kill()
    sys.exit(1)


def run_claude_agent(api_key, base_url, config):
    """运行 Claude Agent"""
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("Claude Agent Runner - xhs-topic-analyzer")
    print("="*60)

    keywords = config.get("keywords", [])
    filters = config.get("filters", {})
    min_likes = filters.get("min_likes", 2000)

    keywords_str = "、".join(keywords)

    # 构建 MCP 工具配置
    tools = [{
        "type": "computer_20241022",
        "name": "mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds",
        "computer_20241022": {
            "mcp_server": {
                "url": "http://localhost:3000"
            }
        }
    }]

    # 初始化 Anthropic 客户端
    print("\n[Step 1] 初始化 Anthropic 客户端...")
    print(f"  - Base URL: {base_url}")
    print(f"  - Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514")

    client = Anthropic(
        api_key=api_key,

## 🎯 任务目标

{keywords_str}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Claude Agent Runner for GitHub Actions
使用 Anthropic SDK (通过硅基流动代理) + 小红书 MCP 搜索爆款笔记
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import subprocess
import time
import requests
from datetime import datetime

try:
    from anthropic import Anthropic
except ImportError:
    print("正在安装 anthropic 包...")
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "anthropic"])
    from anthropic import Anthropic


def load_config():
    """加载配置文件"""
    config_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'config.json')
    try:
        with open(config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] 加载配置文件失败: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


def start_mcp_server(cookies_path):
    """启动小红书 MCP HTTP Server"""
    print("启动小红书 MCP Server...")

    # 检查 xiaohongshu-mcp 是否存在（GitHub Actions 环境中已预安装）
    try:
        subprocess.run(["which", "xiaohongshu-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True)
        print("✓ xiaohongshu-mcp 已就绪")
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
        print("[Error] xiaohongshu-mcp 未找到")
        print("请确保在 GitHub Actions 中已正确安装 xiaohongshu-mcp")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 启动 MCP Server
    cmd = [
        "xiaohongshu-mcp", "serve",
        "--port", "18060",
        "--cookies", cookies_path
    ]

    process = subprocess.Popen(
        cmd,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True
    )

    # 等待服务启动
    print("等待 MCP Server 启动...")
    for i in range(15):
        try:
            response = requests.get("http://localhost:18060/health", timeout=2)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
                return process
        except:
            pass
        print(f"等待中... ({i+1}/15)")
        time.sleep(2)

    # 检查是否成功启动
    try:
        response = requests.get("http://localhost:18060/health", timeout=2)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
            return process
    except:
        pass

    print("[Error] MCP Server 启动失败")
    print("查看日志:")
    print(process.stderr.read())
    process.kill()
    sys.exit(1)


def run_claude_agent(api_key, base_url, config):
    """运行 Claude Agent"""
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("Claude Agent Runner - xhs-topic-analyzer")
    print("="*60)

    keywords = config.get("keywords", [])
    filters = config.get("filters", {})
    min_likes = filters.get("min_likes", 2000)

    keywords_str = "、".join(keywords)

    # 构建 MCP 工具配置
    tools = [{
        "type": "computer_20241022",
        "name": "mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds",
        "computer_20241022": {
            "mcp_server": {
                "url": "http://localhost:18060"
            }
        }
    }]

    # 初始化 Anthropic 客户端
    print("\n[Step 1] 初始化 Anthropic 客户端...")
    print(f"  - Base URL: {base_url}")
    print(f"  - Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514")

    client = Anthropic(
        api_key=api_key,
        base_url=base_url
    )

    # 构建任务提示词
    print(f"\n[Step 2] 构建任务提示词...")
    task_prompt = f"""请执行小红书财经赛道爆款笔记分析任务：

## 🎯 任务目标
搜索小红书财经赛道关键词，提取近期爆款笔记（点赞≥2000）

## 📋 搜索关键词
{keywords_str}

## ⚙️ 搜索参数
每个关键词调用 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds，参数：
- keyword: <关键词>
- filters:
  - sort_by: "最多点赞"
  - publish_time: "一周内"
  - note_type: "不限"

## 🔍 执行步骤
1. 对每个关键词调用搜索 API
2. 合并所有搜索结果
3. 筛选条件：点赞数 ≥ {min_likes}
4. 去重（按笔记ID）
5. 按点赞数降序排列
6. 保存到 data.json 文件

## 📄 输出格式
```json
{{
  "feeds": [{{
    "id": "笔记ID",
    "title": "标题",
    "user": "博主昵称",
    "liked_count": 点赞数,
    "collected_count": 收藏数,
    "comment_count": 评论数,
    "type": "类型",
    "keyword": "来源关键词"
  }}],
  "total_feeds": <总数>,
  "fetched_at": "<时间戳>"
}}
```

## ⚠️ 重要提醒
- 必须调用真实的 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds API
- 不能编造数据
- 需要完整搜索所有 {len(keywords)} 个关键词

请开始执行任务！
"""

    # 调用 Claude API
    print(f"\n[Step 3] 调用 Claude API...")
    print(f"  - Keywords: {len(keywords)} 个")
    print(f"  - Max tokens: 16384")
    print(f"  - Tools: mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds")

    try:
        response = client.messages.create(
            model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
            max_tokens=16384,
            tools=tools,
            messages=[{
                "role": "user",
                "content": task_prompt
            }]
        )

        print(f"\n  ✓ API 调用成功")
        print(f"  - Usage: {response.usage.total_tokens} tokens")
        print(f"  - Input: {response.usage.input_tokens} tokens")
        print(f"  - Output: {response.usage.output_tokens} tokens")

        return response

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n[Error] Claude API 调用失败: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)


def main():
    """主函数"""
    # 1. 检查环境变量
    api_key = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN")
    base_url = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "https://api.anthropic.com")
    cookies_json = os.environ.get("XHS_COOKIES")

    if not api_key:
        print("[Error] 缺少 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not cookies_json:
        print("[Error] 缺少 XHS_COOKIES 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 2. 保存 cookies 到临时文件
    cookies_file = "/tmp/xhs_cookies.json"
    with open(cookies_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(cookies_json)
    print(f"✓ Cookies 文件已创建: {cookies_file}")

    # 3. 启动 MCP Server
    mcp_process = start_mcp_server(cookies_file)

    try:
        # 4. 加载配置
        print("\n[Info] 加载配置文件...")
        config = load_config()
        print(f"✓ 已加载 {len(config.get('keywords', []))} 个关键词")

        # 5. 运行 Claude Agent
        response = run_claude_agent(api_key, base_url, config)

        # 6. 检查生成的数据文件
        print("\n[Step 4] 检查生成的数据文件...")
        data_file = "data.json"

        if os.path.exists(data_file):
            with open(data_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                data = json.load(f)

            feeds = data.get("feeds", [])
            print(f"✓ 数据文件已生成")
            print(f"  - 笔记数量: {len(feeds)}")

            if len(feeds) > 0:
                print(f"  - 示例: {feeds[0].get('title', 'N/A')[:50]}...")
                print(f"  - 总点赞数: {sum(f.get('liked_count', 0) for f in feeds):,}")

        else:
            print(f"[Warning] 未找到 {data_file}")
            print("[Info] Claude 响应内容:")
            print(response.content)

    finally:
        # 7. 清理：停止 MCP Server
        print("\n[Step 5] 清理资源...")
        mcp_process.terminate()
        mcp_process.wait()

        # 删除 cookies 文件
        if os.path.exists(cookies_file):
            os.remove(cookies_file)
            print(f"✓ 已删除 {cookies_file}")

        print("✓ 清理完成")

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("✓ Agent Runner 执行完成")
    print("="*60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Claude Agent Runner for GitHub Actions
使用 Anthropic SDK (通过硅基流动代理) + 小红书 MCP 搜索爆款笔记
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import subprocess
import time
import requests
from datetime import datetime

try:
    from anthropic import Anthropic
except ImportError:
    print("正在安装 anthropic 包...")
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "anthropic"])
    from anthropic import Anthropic


def load_config():
    """加载配置文件"""
    config_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'config.json')
    try:
        with open(config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] 加载配置文件失败: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


def start_mcp_server(cookies_path):
    """启动小红书 MCP HTTP Server"""
    print("启动小红书 MCP Server...")

    # 检查 xiaohongshu-mcp 是否存在（GitHub Actions 环境中已预安装）
    try:
        subprocess.run(["which", "xiaohongshu-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True)
        print("✓ xiaohongshu-mcp 已就绪")
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
        print("[Error] xiaohongshu-mcp 未找到")
        print("请确保在 GitHub Actions 中已正确安装 xiaohongshu-mcp")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 启动 MCP Server
    cmd = [
        "xiaohongshu-mcp", "serve",
        "--port", "18060",
        "--cookies", cookies_path
    ]

    process = subprocess.Popen(
        cmd,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True
    )

    # 等待服务启动
    print("等待 MCP Server 启动...")
    for i in range(15):
        try:
            response = requests.get("http://localhost:18060/health", timeout=2)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
                return process
        except:
            pass
        print(f"等待中... ({i+1}/15)")
        time.sleep(2)

    # 检查是否成功启动
    try:
        response = requests.get("http://localhost:18060/health", timeout=2)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
            return process
    except:
        pass

    print("[Error] MCP Server 启动失败")
    print("查看日志:")
    print(process.stderr.read())
    process.kill()
    sys.exit(1)


def run_claude_agent(api_key, base_url, config):
    """运行 Claude Agent"""
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("Claude Agent Runner - xhs-topic-analyzer")
    print("="*60)

    keywords = config.get("keywords", [])
    filters = config.get("filters", {})
    min_likes = filters.get("min_likes", 2000)

    keywords_str = "、".join(keywords)

    # 构建 MCP 工具配置
    tools = [{
        "type": "computer_20241022",
        "name": "mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds",
        "computer_20241022": {
            "mcp_server": {
                "url": "http://localhost:18060"
            }
        }
    }]

    # 初始化 Anthropic 客户端
    print("\n[Step 1] 初始化 Anthropic 客户端...")
    print(f"  - Base URL: {base_url}")
    print(f"  - Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514")

    client = Anthropic(
        api_key=api_key,
        base_url=base_url
    )

    # 构建任务提示词
    print(f"\n[Step 2] 构建任务提示词...")
    task_prompt = f"""请执行小红书财经赛道爆款笔记分析任务：

## 🎯 任务目标
搜索小红书财经赛道关键词，提取近期爆款笔记（点赞≥2000）

## 📋 搜索关键词
{keywords_str}

## ⚙️ 搜索参数
每个关键词调用 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds，参数：
- keyword: <关键词>
- filters:
  - sort_by: "最多点赞"
  - publish_time: "一周内"
  - note_type: "不限"

## 🔍 执行步骤
1. 对每个关键词调用搜索 API
2. 合并所有搜索结果
3. 筛选条件：点赞数 ≥ {min_likes}
4. 去重（按笔记ID）
5. 按点赞数降序排列
6. 保存到 data.json 文件

## 📄 输出格式
```json
{{
  "feeds": [{{
    "id": "笔记ID",
    "title": "标题",
    "user": "博主昵称",
    "liked_count": 点赞数,
    "collected_count": 收藏数,
    "comment_count": 评论数,
    "type": "类型",
    "keyword": "来源关键词"
  }}],
  "total_feeds": <总数>,
  "fetched_at": "<时间戳>"
}}
```

## ⚠️ 重要提醒
- 必须调用真实的 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds API
- 不能编造数据
- 需要完整搜索所有 {len(keywords)} 个关键词

请开始执行任务！
"""

    # 调用 Claude API
    print(f"\n[Step 3] 调用 Claude API...")
    print(f"  - Keywords: {len(keywords)} 个")
    print(f"  - Max tokens: 16384")
    print(f"  - Tools: mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds")

    try:
        response = client.messages.create(
            model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
            max_tokens=16384,
            tools=tools,
            messages=[{
                "role": "user",
                "content": task_prompt
            }],
            timeout=300
        )

        print(f"\n  ✓ API 调用成功")
        print(f"  - Usage: {response.usage.total_tokens} tokens")
        print(f"  - Input: {response.usage.input_tokens} tokens")
        print(f"  - Output: {response.usage.output_tokens} tokens")

        return response

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n[Error] Claude API 调用失败: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)


def main():
    """主函数"""
    # 1. 检查环境变量
    api_key = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN")
    base_url = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "https://api.anthropic.com")
    cookies_json = os.environ.get("XHS_COOKIES")

    if not api_key:
        print("[Error] 缺少 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not cookies_json:
        print("[Error] 缺少 XHS_COOKIES 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 2. 保存 cookies 到临时文件
    cookies_file = "/tmp/xhs_cookies.json"
    with open(cookies_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(cookies_json)
    print(f"✓ Cookies 文件已创建: {cookies_file}")

    # 3. 启动 MCP Server
    mcp_process = start_mcp_server(cookies_file)

    try:
        # 4. 加载配置
        print("\n[Info] 加载配置文件...")
        config = load_config()
        print(f"✓ 已加载 {len(config.get('keywords', []))} 个关键词")

        # 5. 运行 Claude Agent
        response = run_claude_agent(api_key, base_url, config)

        # 6. 检查生成的数据文件
        print("\n[Step 4] 检查生成的数据文件...")
        data_file = "data.json"

        if os.path.exists(data_file):
            with open(data_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                data = json.load(f)

            feeds = data.get("feeds", [])
            print(f"✓ 数据文件已生成")
            print(f"  - 笔记数量: {len(feeds)}")

            if len(feeds) > 0:
                print(f"  - 示例: {feeds[0].get('title', 'N/A')[:50]}...")
                print(f"  - 总点赞数: {sum(f.get('liked_count', 0) for f in feeds):,}")

        else:
            print(f"[Warning] 未找到 {data_file}")
            print("[Info] Claude 响应内容:")
            print(response.content)

    finally:
        # 7. 清理：停止 MCP Server
        print("\n[Step 5] 清理资源...")
        mcp_process.terminate()
        mcp_process.wait()

        # 删除 cookies 文件
        if os.path.exists(cookies_file):
            os.remove(cookies_file)
            print(f"✓ 已删除 {cookies_file}")

        print("✓ 清理完成")

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("✓ Agent Runner 执行完成")
    print("="*60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Claude Agent Runner for GitHub Actions
使用 Anthropic SDK (通过硅基流动代理) + 小红书 MCP 搜索爆款笔记
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import subprocess
import time
import requests
from datetime import datetime

    from anthropic import Anthropic
except ImportError:
    print("正在安装 anthropic 包...")
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "anthropic"])
    from anthropic import Anthropic


def load_config():
    """加载配置文件"""
    config_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'config.json')

        with open(config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:

def start_mcp_server(cookies_path):
    """启动小红书 MCP HTTP Server"""
    print("启动小红书 MCP Server...")

    # 检查 xiaohongshu-mcp 是否存在（GitHub Actions 环境中已预安装）

- ❌ Claude 返回了 10 个 `ToolUseBlock`（工具调用请求）
- ❌ 脚本**没有循环处理**这些工具调用
- ❌ 脚本只是打印了响应内容就结束了
- ❌ `data.json` 文件从未被生成

调用 Claude API → 获得响应（包含工具调用） → 打印响应 → 结束 ❌
```

**正确代码流程** (需要):
```
调用 Claude API → 获得响应 → 处理工具调用块 →
  └─ 循环：检测到 ToolUseBlock？
      ├─ 是：执行 MCP 工具 → 获取结果 → 继续对话
      └─ 否（文本块）：提取结果 → 生成 data.json → 结束 ✓
```

## 🔧 方案 A：完整的 Claude Agent 循环逻辑实现

### 设计方案

#### 核心逻辑
```python
def run_claude_agent_loop(api_key, base_url, config, mcp_server_url):
    """运行 Claude Agent 循环"""
    client = Anthropic(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url)

    # 1. 构建初始消息
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": task_prompt}]

    # 2. 循环处理对话
    max_iterations = 20  # 防止无限循环
    collected_feeds = []

    for iteration in range(max_iterations):
        print(f"\n[Iteration {iteration + 1}] 调用 Claude API...")

        # 调用 Claude API
        response = client.messages.create(
            model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
            max_tokens=4096,
            tools=tools,
            messages=messages,
            timeout=300
        )

        # 3. 处理响应内容
        assistant_response = []
        tool_results = []

        for block in response.content:
            if block.type == "text":
                assistant_response.append(block.text)
            elif block.type == "tool_use":
                print(f"  → 工具调用: {block.name}")

                # 执行 MCP 工具
                tool_result = execute_mcp_tool(
                    block.name,
                    block.input,
                    mcp_server_url
                )
                tool_results.append({
                    "id": block.id,
                    "result": tool_result,
                    "type": "tool_result"
                })

        # 4. 更新消息历史
        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response.content})
        messages.extend(tool_results)

        # 5. 检查是否完成（没有工具调用）
        if not any(block.type == "tool_use" for block in response.content):
            print("\n✓ Agent 执行完成")

            # 6. 提取并保存数据
            final_text = "\n".join(assistant_response)
            data = parse_and_save_data(final_text, collected_feeds)
            return data

        print(f"  → 继续对话...")

    print("[Error] 超过最大迭代次数")
    sys.exit(1)


def execute_mcp_tool(tool_name, tool_input, mcp_server_url):
    """执行 MCP 工具调用"""
    # 通过 HTTP 调用 MCP Server
    url = f"{mcp_server_url}/mcp"

    payload = {
        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
        "id": 1,
        "method": "tools/call",
        "params": {
            "name": tool_name,
            "arguments": tool_input
        }
    }

    response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=60)
    response.raise_for_status()

    result = response.json()
    if "error" in result:
        raise Exception(f"MCP 工具调用失败: {result['error']}")

    return result.get("result", {})
```

### 实现要点

#### 1. 消息历史管理
- 每次迭代都要更新消息历史
- 包含：用户消息、助手响应、工具结果

#### 2. 工具调用检测
- 检查 `response.content` 中是否有 `tool_use` 类型块
- 如果没有，说明 Claude 已经完成工作

#### 3. MCP 工具执行
- 通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 调用 MCP Server
- 端点：`http://localhost:18060/mcp`
- 方法：`tools/call`

#### 4. 数据提取和保存
- 从最终的文本响应中提取 JSON 数据
- 或者要求 Claude 以代码块形式返回 JSON
- 保存到 `data.json`

---

## 📝 具体实施步骤

### 步骤 1: 重写 `run_claude_agent` 函数

**文件**: `/tmp/xhs-topic-analyzer/scripts/claude_agent_runner.py`

**关键修改**:
- 移除单次 API 调用逻辑
- 实现循环对话逻辑
- 添加工具调用处理
- 添加数据提取和保存

            return data

        print(f"  → 继续对话...")

    print("[Error] 超过最大迭代次数")
    sys.exit(1)

## 🔧 方案 A：完整的 Claude Agent 循环逻辑实现

### 设计方案

#### 核心逻辑
```python
def run_claude_agent_loop(api_key, base_url, config, mcp_server_url):
    """运行 Claude Agent 循环"""
    client = Anthropic(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url)

    # 1. 构建初始消息
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": task_prompt}]

    # 2. 循环处理对话
    max_iterations = 20  # 防止无限循环
    collected_feeds = []

    for iteration in range(max_iterations):
        print(f"\n[Iteration {iteration + 1}] 调用 Claude API...")

        # 调用 Claude API
        response = client.messages.create(
            model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
            max_tokens=4096,
            tools=tools,
            messages=messages,
            timeout=300
        )

        # 3. 处理响应内容
        assistant_response = []
        tool_results = []

        for block in response.content:
            if block.type == "text":
                assistant_response.append(block.text)
            elif block.type == "tool_use":
                print(f"  → 工具调用: {block.name}")

                # 执行 MCP 工具
                tool_result = execute_mcp_tool(
                    block.name,
                    block.input,
                    mcp_server_url
                )
                tool_results.append({
                    "id": block.id,
                    "result": tool_result,
                    "type": "tool_result"
                })

        # 4. 更新消息历史
        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response.content})
        messages.extend(tool_results)

        # 5. 检查是否完成（没有工具调用）
        if not any(block.type == "tool_use" for block in response.content):
            print("\n✓ Agent 执行完成")

            # 6. 提取并保存数据
            final_text = "\n".join(assistant_response)
            data = parse_and_save_data(final_text, collected_feeds)
            return data

        print(f"  → 继续对话...")

    print("[Error] 超过最大迭代次数")
    sys.exit(1)


def execute_mcp_tool(tool_name, tool_input, mcp_server_url):
    """执行 MCP 工具调用"""
    # 通过 HTTP 调用 MCP Server
    url = f"{mcp_server_url}/mcp"

    payload = {
        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
        "id": 1,
        "method": "tools/call",
        "params": {
            "name": tool_name,
            "arguments": tool_input
        }
    }

    response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=60)
    response.raise_for_status()

    result = response.json()
    if "error" in result:
        raise Exception(f"MCP 工具调用失败: {result['error']}")

    return result.get("result", {})
```

### 实现要点

#### 1. 消息历史管理
- 每次迭代都要更新消息历史
- 包含：用户消息、助手响应、工具结果

#### 2. 工具调用检测
- 检查 `response.content` 中是否有 `tool_use` 类型块
- 如果没有，说明 Claude 已经完成工作

#### 3. MCP 工具执行
- 通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 调用 MCP Server
- 端点：`http://localhost:18060/mcp`
- 方法：`tools/call`

#### 4. 数据提取和保存
- 从最终的文本响应中提取 JSON 数据
- 或者要求 Claude 以代码块形式返回 JSON
- 保存到 `data.json`

import re

def extract_json_from_text(text):
    """从文本中提取 JSON"""
    # 尝试匹配代码块
    pattern = r'```json\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```'
    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        json_str = match.group(1)
        return json.loads(json_str)

    # 尝试直接解析整个文本
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except:
        pass

    # 查找 JSON 对象模式
    pattern = r'\{[^{}]*\{[^{}]*\}[^{}]*\}'
    match = re.search(pattern, text)
    if match:
        return json.loads(match.group(0))

    raise ValueError("无法从响应中提取 JSON 数据")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Claude Agent Runner for GitHub Actions
使用 Anthropic SDK (通过硅基流动代理) + 小红书 MCP 搜索爆款笔记
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import subprocess
import time
import requests
from datetime import datetime

try:
    from anthropic import Anthropic
except ImportError:
    print("正在安装 anthropic 包...")
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "anthropic"])
    from anthropic import Anthropic


def load_config():
    """加载配置文件"""
    config_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'config.json')
    try:
        with open(config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] 加载配置文件失败: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


def start_mcp_server(cookies_path):
    """启动小红书 MCP HTTP Server"""
    print("启动小红书 MCP Server...")

    # 检查 xiaohongshu-mcp 是否存在（GitHub Actions 环境中已预安装）
    try:
        subprocess.run(["which", "xiaohongshu-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True)
        print("✓ xiaohongshu-mcp 已就绪")
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
        print("[Error] xiaohongshu-mcp 未找到")
        print("请确保在 GitHub Actions 中已正确安装 xiaohongshu-mcp")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 启动 MCP Server
    cmd = [
        "xiaohongshu-mcp", "serve",
        "--port", "18060",
        "--cookies", cookies_path
    ]

    process = subprocess.Popen(
        cmd,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True
    )

    # 等待服务启动
    print("等待 MCP Server 启动...")
    for i in range(15):
        try:
            response = requests.get("http://localhost:18060/health", timeout=2)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
                return process
        except:
            pass
        print(f"等待中... ({i+1}/15)")
        time.sleep(2)

    # 检查是否成功启动
    try:
        response = requests.get("http://localhost:18060/health", timeout=2)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
            return process
    except:
        pass

    print("[Error] MCP Server 启动失败")
    print("查看日志:")
    print(process.stderr.read())
    process.kill()
    sys.exit(1)


def run_claude_agent(api_key, base_url, config):
    """运行 Claude Agent"""
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("Claude Agent Runner - xhs-topic-analyzer")
    print("="*60)

    keywords = config.get("keywords", [])
    filters = config.get("filters", {})
    min_likes = filters.get("min_likes", 2000)

    keywords_str = "、".join(keywords)

    # 构建 MCP 工具配置
    tools = [{
        "type": "computer_20241022",
        "name": "mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds",
        "computer_20241022": {
            "mcp_server": {
                "url": "http://localhost:18060"
            }
        }
    }]

    # 初始化 Anthropic 客户端
    print("\n[Step 1] 初始化 Anthropic 客户端...")
    print(f"  - Base URL: {base_url}")
    print(f"  - Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514")

    client = Anthropic(
        api_key=api_key,
        base_url=base_url
    )

    # 构建任务提示词
    print(f"\n[Step 2] 构建任务提示词...")
    task_prompt = f"""请执行小红书财经赛道爆款笔记分析任务：

## 🎯 任务目标
搜索小红书财经赛道关键词，提取近期爆款笔记（点赞≥2000）

## 📋 搜索关键词
{keywords_str}

## ⚙️ 搜索参数
每个关键词调用 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds，参数：
- keyword: <关键词>
- filters:
  - sort_by: "最多点赞"
  - publish_time: "一周内"
  - note_type: "不限"

## 🔍 执行步骤

2. 合并所有搜索结果

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Claude Agent Runner for GitHub Actions
使用 Anthropic SDK + 小红书 MCP 搜索爆款笔记
实现完整的 Agent 循环逻辑
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import subprocess
import time
import requests
import re
from datetime import datetime

try:
    from anthropic import Anthropic
except ImportError:
    print("正在安装 anthropic 包...")
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "anthropic"])
    from anthropic import Anthropic


def load_config():
    """加载配置文件"""
    config_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'config.json')
    try:
        with open(config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] 加载配置文件失败: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


def start_mcp_server(cookies_path):
    """启动小红书 MCP HTTP Server"""
    print("启动小红书 MCP Server...")

    # 检查 xiaohongshu-mcp 是否存在
    try:
        subprocess.run(["which", "xiaohongshu-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True)
        print("✓ xiaohongshu-mcp 已就绪")
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
        print("[Error] xiaohongshu-mcp 未找到")
        print("请确保在 GitHub Actions 中已正确安装 xiaohongshu-mcp")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 启动 MCP Server
    cmd = [
        "xiaohongshu-mcp", "serve",
        "--port", "18060",
        "--cookies", cookies_path
    ]

    process = subprocess.Popen(
        cmd,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True
    )

    # 等待服务启动
    print("等待 MCP Server 启动...")
    for i in range(15):
        try:
            response = requests.get("http://localhost:18060/health", timeout=2)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
                return process
        except:
            pass
        print(f"等待中... ({i+1}/15)")
        time.sleep(2)

    # 检查是否成功启动
    try:
        response = requests.get("http://localhost:18060/health", timeout=2)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            print("✓ MCP Server 已就绪")
            return process
    except:
        pass

    print("[Error] MCP Server 启动失败")
    print("查看日志:")
    print(process.stderr.read())
    process.kill()
    sys.exit(1)


def execute_mcp_tool(tool_name, tool_input, mcp_server_url):
    """执行 MCP 工具调用"""
    print(f"  → 执行工具: {tool_name}")

    url = f"{mcp_server_url}/mcp"

    payload = {
        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
        "id": 1,
        "method": "tools/call",
        "params": {
            "name": tool_name,
            "arguments": tool_input
        }
    }

    try:
        response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=60)
        response.raise_for_status()

        result = response.json()

        if "error" in result:
            print(f"  ✗ 工具调用失败: {result['error']}")
            return None

        tool_result = result.get("result", {})

        # 尝试解析结果中的内容
        if isinstance(tool_result, dict):
            content = tool_result.get("content", [])
            if isinstance(content, list) and len(content) > 0:
                first_item = content[0]
                if isinstance(first_item, dict):
                    print(f"  ✓ 返回 {len(content)} 条结果")
                    # 打印第一条结果的标题
                    title = first_item.get("displayTitle", first_item.get("title", "N/A"))
                    if title != "N/A":
                        print(f"     示例: {title[:40]}...")
                return tool_result
            elif isinstance(tool_result, str):
                print(f"  ✓ 返回文本结果")
                return tool_result
        else:
            print(f"  ✓ 工具调用成功")
            return tool_result

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ✗ 工具调用异常: {e}")
        return None


def extract_json_from_text(text):
    """从文本中提取 JSON 数据"""
    print("  → 尝试从响应中提取 JSON...")

    # 方案 1: 尝试匹配代码块
    patterns = [
        r'```json\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```',  # ```json {...} ```
        r'```\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```',          # ``` {...} ```
        r'\{[^{}]*\{[^{}]*\}[^{}]*\}',  # 简单的 JSON 对象
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:
        try:
            match = re.search(pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
            if match:
                json_str = match.group(1) if match.lastindex else match.group(0)
                data = json.loads(json_str)
                print(f"  ✓ 成功提取 JSON")
                return data
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, IndexError):
            continue

    # 方案 2: 尝试直接解析整个文本
    try:
        data = json.loads(text.strip())
        print(f"  ✓ 直接解析成功")
        return data
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        pass

    print("  ✗ 无法提取 JSON 数据")
    return None


def parse_and_save_data(response_text, collected_feeds):
    """从响应中提取数据并保存到 data.json"""
    print("\n[Step 4] 提取并保存数据...")

    # 尝试提取 JSON
    data = extract_json_from_text(response_text)

    if not data:
        print("[Error] 无法从 Claude 响应中提取 JSON 数据")
        print("[Info] 响应内容:")
        print(response_text[:500])
        sys.exit(1)

    # 保存到 data.json
    try:
        with open("data.json", 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

        feeds = data.get("feeds", [])
        print(f"✓ 数据已保存到 data.json")
        print(f"  - 笔记数量: {len(feeds)}")

        if len(feeds) > 0:
            total_likes = sum(f.get('likedCount', f.get('likes', 0)) for f in feeds)
            print(f"  - 总点赞数: {total_likes:,}")

        return data

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] 保存数据失败: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


def run_claude_agent_loop(api_key, base_url, config, mcp_server_url):
    """运行 Claude Agent 循环（核心函数）"""
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("Claude Agent Runner - xhs-topic-analyzer")
    print("="*60)

    keywords = config.get("keywords", [])
    filters = config.get("filters", {})
    min_likes = filters.get("min_likes", 2000)

    keywords_str = "、".join(keywords)

    # 构建 MCP 工具配置
    tools = [{
        "type": "computer_20241022",
        "name": "mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds",
        "computer_20241022": {
            "mcp_server": {
                "url": mcp_server_url
            }
        }
    }]

    # 初始化 Anthropic 客户端
    print("\n[Step 1] 初始化 Anthropic 客户端...")
    print(f"  - Base URL: {base_url}")
    print(f"  - Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514")

    client = Anthropic(
        api_key=api_key,
        base_url=base_url
    )

    # 构建任务提示词
    print(f"\n[Step 2] 构建任务提示词...")

    task_prompt = f"""请执行小红书财经赛道爆款笔记分析任务：

## 🎯 任务目标
搜索小红书财经赛道关键词，提取近期爆款笔记（点赞≥{min_likes}）

## 📋 搜索关键词
{keywords_str}

## ⚙️ 搜索参数
对每个关键词调用 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds：
- filters:
  - sort_by: "最多点赞"
  - publish_time: "一周内"
  - note_type: "不限"

## 🔍 执行步骤
1. 对每个关键词调用搜索 API
2. 合并所有搜索结果
3. 筛选条件：点赞数 ≥ {min_likes}
4. 去重（按笔记ID）
5. 按点赞数降序排列

## 📄 输出格式
完成搜索后，**必须**将结果以 JSON 格式返回。

使用以下格式（注意字段名必须完全匹配）：

```json
{{
  "feeds": [
    {{
      "id": "笔记ID",
      "title": "标题",
      "nickname": "博主昵称",
      "likedCount": 点赞数,
      "collectedCount": 收藏数,
      "commentCount": 评论数,
      "publishTime": "发布时间"
    }}
  ],
  "keywords": {json.dumps(keywords, ensure_ascii=False)},
  "fetched_at": "{datetime.now().isoformat()}"
}}
```

**⚠️ 重要**：
- 必须调用真实的 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds API
- 不能编造数据
- 必须在完成所有搜索后返回 JSON 格式数据
- 不要只调用工具而不返回结果

请开始执行任务！
"""

    # 1. 构建初始消息
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": task_prompt}]

    # 2. 循环处理对话
    max_iterations = 20  # 防止无限循环
    iteration = 0

    for iteration in range(max_iterations):
        iteration += 1
        print(f"\n[Iteration {iteration}] 调用 Claude API...")

        try:
            # 调用 Claude API
            response = client.messages.create(
                model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
                max_tokens=4096,
                tools=tools,
                messages=messages,
                timeout=300
            )

            # 显示 token 使用情况
            usage = response.usage.model_dump() if hasattr(response.usage, 'model_dump') else response.usage
            print(f"  - Tokens: {usage.get('input_tokens', 0)} input + {usage.get('output_tokens', 0)} output")

            # 3. 处理响应内容
            assistant_response_text = []
            tool_results = []
            has_tool_use = False

            for block in response.content:
                if block.type == "text":
                    assistant_response_text.append(block.text)
                elif block.type == "tool_use":
                    has_tool_use = True
                    print(f"  → 工具调用: {block.name}")

                    # 执行 MCP 工具
                    tool_result = execute_mcp_tool(
                        block.name,
                        block.input,
                        mcp_server_url
                    )

                    if tool_result:
                        tool_results.append({
                            "tool_use_id": block.id,
                            "content": json.dumps(tool_result, ensure_ascii=False),
                            "type": "tool_result"
                        })
                    else:
                        print(f"  ✗ 工具调用失败")
                        # 添加错误结果
                        tool_results.append({
                            "tool_use_id": block.id,
                            "content": json.dumps({"error": "工具调用失败"}, ensure_ascii=False),
                            "type": "tool_result"
                        })

            # 4. 更新消息历史
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response.content})
            messages.extend(tool_results)

            # 5. 检查是否完成（没有工具调用）
            if not has_tool_use:
                print("\n✓ Agent 执行完成（无更多工具调用）")

                # 合并所有文本响应
                final_text = "\n\n".join(assistant_response_text)
                print(f"\n[Info] 最终响应长度: {len(final_text)} 字符")

                # 6. 提取并保存数据
                data = parse_and_save_data(final_text, [])
                return data

            else:
                print(f"  → 续续对话...")

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"\n[Error] API 调用失败: {e}")
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            sys.exit(1)

    # 如果超过最大迭代次数
    print(f"\n[Error] 超过最大迭代次数 ({max_iterations})")
    sys.exit(1)


def main():
    """主函数"""
    # 1. 检查环境变量
    api_key = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN")
    base_url = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "https://api.anthropic.com")
    cookies_json = os.environ.get("XHS_COOKIES")

    if not api_key:
        print("[Error] 缺少 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not cookies_json:
        print("[Error] 缺少 XHS_COOKIES 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 2. 保存 cookies 到临时文件
    cookies_file = "/tmp/xhs_cookies.json"
    with open(cookies_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(cookies_json)
    print(f"✓ Cookies 文件已创建: {cookies_file}")

    # 3. 启动 MCP Server
    mcp_process = start_mcp_server(cookies_file)

    try:
        # 4. 加载配置
        print("\n[Info] 加载配置文件...")
        config = load_config()
        print(f"✓ 已加载 {len(config.get('keywords', []))} 个关键词")

        # 5. 运行 Claude Agent 循环
        mcp_server_url = "http://localhost:18060"
        data = run_claude_agent_loop(api_key, base_url, config, mcp_server_url)

        # 6. 验证生成的数据
        print("\n[Step 5] 验证生成的数据...")
        feeds = data.get("feeds", [])

        if len(feeds) == 0:
            print("[Warning] 未找到符合条件的笔记")
            print("这可能是因为:")
            print("  - 关键词太冷门")
            print("  - 筛选条件太严格（min_likes ≥ 2000）")
            print("  - 时间范围太窄（一周内）")
        else:
            print(f"✓ 成功采集 {len(feeds)} 条笔记")

    finally:
        # 7. 清理：停止 MCP Server
        print("\n[Step 6] 清理资源...")
        mcp_process.terminate()
        mcp_process.wait()

        # 删除 cookies 文件
        if os.path.exists(cookies_file):
            os.remove(cookies_file)
            print(f"✓ 已删除 {cookies_file}")

        print("✓ 清理完成")

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("✓ Agent Runner 执行完成")
    print("="*60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""

import os

import time
import requests

try:

except ImportError:
    print("正在安装 anthropic 包...")
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "anthropic"])

    """加载配置文件"""
    config_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'config.json')
    try:
        with open(config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] 加载配置文件失败: {e}")

    """启动小红书 MCP HTTP Server"""
    print("启动小红书 MCP Server...")

    # 检查 xiaohongshu-mcp 是否存在
    try:
        subprocess.run(["which", "xiaohongshu-mcp"], capture_output=True, check=True)
        print("✓ xiaohongshu-mcp 已就绪")
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
        print("[Error] xiaohongshu-mcp 未找到")
        print("请确保在 GitHub Actions 中已正确安装 xiaohongshu-mcp")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 启动 MCP Server
    cmd = [
        "xiaohongshu-mcp", "serve",
        "--port", "18060",

    ]

        }

def execute_mcp_tool(tool_name, tool_input, mcp_server_url):
    """执行 MCP 工具调用"""
    print(f"  → 执行工具: {tool_name}")

    url = f"{mcp_server_url}/mcp"

    payload = {
        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
        "id": 1,
        "method": "tools/call",
        "params": {
            "name": tool_name,
            "arguments": tool_input
        }
    }

    try:
        response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=60)
        response.raise_for_status()

        result = response.json()

        if "error" in result:
            print(f"  ✗ 工具调用失败: {result['error']}")
            return None

        tool_result = result.get("result", {})

        # 尝试解析结果中的内容
        if isinstance(tool_result, dict):
            content = tool_result.get("content", [])
            if isinstance(content, list) and len(content) > 0:
                first_item = content[0]
                if isinstance(first_item, dict):
                    print(f"  ✓ 返回 {len(content)} 条结果")
                    # 打印第一条结果的标题
                    title = first_item.get("displayTitle", first_item.get("title", "N/A"))
                    if title != "N/A":
                        print(f"     示例: {title[:40]}...")
                return tool_result
            elif isinstance(tool_result, str):
                print(f"  ✓ 返回文本结果")
                return tool_result
        else:
            print(f"  ✓ 工具调用成功")
            return tool_result

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ✗ 工具调用异常: {e}")
        return None


def extract_json_from_text(text):
    """从文本中提取 JSON 数据"""
    print("  → 尝试从响应中提取 JSON...")

    # 方案 1: 尝试匹配代码块
    patterns = [
        r'```json\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```',  # ```json {...} ```
        r'```\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```',          # ``` {...} ```
        r'\{[^{}]*\{[^{}]*\}[^{}]*\}',  # 简单的 JSON 对象
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:
        try:
            match = re.search(pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
            if match:
                json_str = match.group(1) if match.lastindex else match.group(0)
                data = json.loads(json_str)
                print(f"  ✓ 成功提取 JSON")
                return data
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, IndexError):
            continue

    # 方案 2: 尝试直接解析整个文本
    try:
        data = json.loads(text.strip())
        print(f"  ✓ 直接解析成功")
        return data
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        pass

    print("  ✗ 无法提取 JSON 数据")
    return None


def parse_and_save_data(response_text, collected_feeds):
    """从响应中提取数据并保存到 data.json"""
    print("\n[Step 4] 提取并保存数据...")

    # 尝试提取 JSON
    data = extract_json_from_text(response_text)

    if not data:
        print("[Error] 无法从 Claude 响应中提取 JSON 数据")
        print("[Info] 响应内容:")
        print(response_text[:500])
        sys.exit(1)

    # 保存到 data.json
    try:
        with open("data.json", 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

        feeds = data.get("feeds", [])
        print(f"✓ 数据已保存到 data.json")
        print(f"  - 笔记数量: {len(feeds)}")

        if len(feeds) > 0:
            total_likes = sum(f.get('likedCount', f.get('likes', 0)) for f in feeds)
            print(f"  - 总点赞数: {total_likes:,}")

        return data

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] 保存数据失败: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


def run_claude_agent_loop(api_key, base_url, config, mcp_server_url):
    """运行 Claude Agent 循环（核心函数）"""
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("Claude Agent Runner - xhs-topic-analyzer")
    print("="*60)

    keywords = config.get("keywords", [])
    filters = config.get("filters", {})
    min_likes = filters.get("min_likes", 2000)

    keywords_str = "、".join(keywords)

    # 构建 MCP 工具配置
    tools = [{
        "type": "computer_20241022",
        "name": "mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds",
        "computer_20241022": {
            "mcp_server": {
                "url": mcp_server_url
            }
        }
    }]

    # 初始化 Anthropic 客户端
    print("\n[Step 1] 初始化 Anthropic 客户端...")
    print(f"  - Base URL: {base_url}")
    print(f"  - Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514")

    client = Anthropic(
        api_key=api_key,
        base_url=base_url
    )

    # 构建任务提示词
    print(f"\n[Step 2] 构建任务提示词...")

    task_prompt = f"""请执行小红书财经赛道爆款笔记分析任务：

## 🎯 任务目标
搜索小红书财经赛道关键词，提取近期爆款笔记（点赞≥{min_likes}）

## 📋 搜索关键词
{keywords_str}

## ⚙️ 搜索参数
对每个关键词调用 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds：
- filters:
  - sort_by: "最多点赞"
  - publish_time: "一周内"
  - note_type: "不限"

## 🔍 执行步骤
1. 对每个关键词调用搜索 API
2. 合并所有搜索结果
3. 筛选条件：点赞数 ≥ {min_likes}
4. 去重（按笔记ID）
5. 按点赞数降序排列

## 📄 输出格式
完成搜索后，**必须**将结果以 JSON 格式返回。

使用以下格式（注意字段名必须完全匹配）：

```json
{{
  "feeds": [
    {{
      "id": "笔记ID",
      "title": "标题",
      "nickname": "博主昵称",
      "likedCount": 点赞数,
      "collectedCount": 收藏数,
      "commentCount": 评论数,
      "publishTime": "发布时间"
    }}
  ],
  "keywords": {json.dumps(keywords, ensure_ascii=False)},
  "fetched_at": "{datetime.now().isoformat()}"
}}
```

**⚠️ 重要**：
- 必须调用真实的 mcp__xiaohongshu__search_feeds API
- 不能编造数据
- 必须在完成所有搜索后返回 JSON 格式数据
- 不要只调用工具而不返回结果

请开始执行任务！
"""

    # 1. 构建初始消息
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": task_prompt}]

    # 2. 循环处理对话
    max_iterations = 20  # 防止无限循环
    iteration = 0

    for iteration in range(max_iterations):
        iteration += 1
        print(f"\n[Iteration {iteration}] 调用 Claude API...")

        try:
            # 调用 Claude API
            response = client.messages.create(
                model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
                max_tokens=4096,
                tools=tools,
                messages=messages,
                timeout=300
            )

            # 显示 token 使用情况
            usage = response.usage.model_dump() if hasattr(response.usage, 'model_dump') else response.usage
            print(f"  - Tokens: {usage.get('input_tokens', 0)} input + {usage.get('output_tokens', 0)} output")

            # 3. 处理响应内容
            assistant_response_text = []
            tool_results = []
            has_tool_use = False

            for block in response.content:
                if block.type == "text":
                    assistant_response_text.append(block.text)
                elif block.type == "tool_use":
                    has_tool_use = True
                    print(f"  → 工具调用: {block.name}")

                    # 执行 MCP 工具
                    tool_result = execute_mcp_tool(
                        block.name,
                        block.input,
                        mcp_server_url
                    )

                    if tool_result:
                        tool_results.append({
                            "tool_use_id": block.id,
                            "content": json.dumps(tool_result, ensure_ascii=False),
                            "type": "tool_result"
                        })
                    else:
                        print(f"  ✗ 工具调用失败")
                        # 添加错误结果
                        tool_results.append({
                            "tool_use_id": block.id,
                            "content": json.dumps({"error": "工具调用失败"}, ensure_ascii=False),
                            "type": "tool_result"
                        })

            # 4. 更新消息历史
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response.content})
            messages.extend(tool_results)

            # 5. 检查是否完成（没有工具调用）
            if not has_tool_use:
                print("\n✓ Agent 执行完成（无更多工具调用）")

                # 合并所有文本响应
                final_text = "\n\n".join(assistant_response_text)
                print(f"\n[Info] 最终响应长度: {len(final_text)} 字符")

                # 6. 提取并保存数据
                data = parse_and_save_data(final_text, [])
                return data

            else:
                print(f"  → 续续对话...")

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"\n[Error] API 调用失败: {e}")
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            sys.exit(1)

    # 如果超过最大迭代次数
    print(f"\n[Error] 超过最大迭代次数 ({max_iterations})")
    sys.exit(1)


def main():
    """主函数"""
    # 1. 检查环境变量
    api_key = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN")
    base_url = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "https://api.anthropic.com")
    cookies_json = os.environ.get("XHS_COOKIES")

    if not api_key:
        print("[Error] 缺少 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not cookies_json:
        print("[Error] 缺少 XHS_COOKIES 环境变量")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 2. 保存 cookies 到临时文件
    cookies_file = "/tmp/xhs_cookies.json"
    with open(cookies_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(cookies_json)
    print(f"✓ Cookies 文件已创建: {cookies_file}")

    # 3. 启动 MCP Server
    mcp_process = start_mcp_server(cookies_file)

    try:
        # 4. 加载配置
        print("\n[Info] 加载配置文件...")
        config = load_config()
        print(f"✓ 已加载 {len(config.get('keywords', []))} 个关键词")

        # 5. 运行 Claude Agent 循环
        mcp_server_url = "http://localhost:18060"
        data = run_claude_agent_loop(api_key, base_url, config, mcp_server_url)

        # 6. 验证生成的数据
        print("\n[Step 5] 验证生成的数据...")
        feeds = data.get("feeds", [])

        if len(feeds) == 0:
            print("[Warning] 未找到符合条件的笔记")
            print("这可能是因为:")
            print("  - 关键词太冷门")
            print("  - 筛选条件太严格（min_likes ≥ 2000）")
            print("  - 时间范围太窄（一周内）")
        else:
            print(f"✓ 成功采集 {len(feeds)} 条笔记")

    finally:
        # 7. 清理：停止 MCP Server
        print("\n[Step 6] 清理资源...")
        mcp_process.terminate()
        mcp_process.wait()

        # 删除 cookies 文件
        if os.path.exists(cookies_file):
            os.remove(cookies_file)
            print(f"✓ 已删除 {cookies_file}")

        print("✓ 清理完成")

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("✓ Agent Runner 执行完成")
    print("="*60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
